description: This file is a Flutter application entry point that defines the main widget structure for a Tic Tac Toe frontend. It sets up the app theme and a basic scaffold with a loading message, indicating that the app is in generation phase.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Stateless widget that sets up the MaterialApp with theme and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main page with a title and some UI elements.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class for MyHomePage that builds a scaffold with an app bar and a message indicating app generation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entrypoint of the Dart application that runs the MyApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Overrides the build method in MyApp and _MyHomePageState to construct the widget tree.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Returns the state object for MyHomePage widget.
